title: Zesty Peppery Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A festive Saudi Arabian dish featuring lamb, raspberry jam, and beurre monte, perfect for a special occasion. This macrobiotic friendly recipe is peppery and pillowy, with a unique flavor combination.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together raspberry jam, beurre monte, black pepper, cumin, coriander, and salt.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with additional black pepper if desired.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb is cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the lamb kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
